honestCaveats: Zero-GPU / zero-model mode runs test gates, code-fingerprint stale detection, OCC handoffs, 12-language code graph, pulse, and exact full-text passage search with zero GPU. The RTX 4080 Super numbers above measure only the optional local 9B LLM synthesis & extraction layer (qwen3.5:9b).

Current repository Q&A figures were measured on Cairnmind's own 440-file repository. Run `cairnmind eval repository /path/to/any-repo` to reproduce them on your own codebase. Ordinary laptop measurements are tracked in issue #35.
On Apple M3 Pro, a single extraction call took up to 52 s in one measured run (docs/evaluation/RESULTS.md).

In prompt-injection testing (22 Nov 2026, main 3ea6aa1), answers (0/12) and the built-in agent (0/9) ignored every planted instruction, while automatic extraction restated canaries planted in a README and code comment (6/12). That is why extracted records always stay proposed until a person confirms them.
An acknowledgement proves a session received and echoed specific plan/task versions, not that the underlying LLM understood them.
